$comment: Declared, expiring waivers for coverage.exclude globs in vitest.config.ts that name
code something actually imports. scripts/check-ci-dormancy.mjs fails the build for any
such glob that is NOT listed here, and for any listing whose reviewBy date has passed.
Issue #309: the previous mechanism was a code comment saying 'REMOVE this line when a
consumer lands'; ten consumers landed and the comment stayed.

src/features/chat-messages/**.reason: 69 modules, 8 test files. Now imported by the live chat layer (processes/chat, widgets/chat-box, features/toolkits), so the original 'no consumer yet' reason is void. Measuring it today drops the merged run under the 80% gate; the unit needs tests before the exclusion can go, and this waiver is the deadline for that rather than a permanent pass.
